column1: # Curated candidate endolysins with reported or plausible activity against Acinetobacter baumannii.

# reports mismatches). Several of these are documented to carry an intrinsic, C-terminal,
# cationic/amphipathic, outer-membrane-active module (the direct precedent for the "amphipathic
# helix" premise): notably LysAB2 (-> peptide LysAB2-P3) and PlyF307 (-> peptide P307).
# name         accession(guess) source_phage_or_host        note / key reference
LysAB2         AGC38657         Acinetobacter phage phiAB2   C-term amphipathic peptide LysAB2-P3; Peng 2017 Sci Rep
PlyF307        AKQ00080         A. baumannii prophage        C-term helix -> peptide P307; Lood 2015 AAC
LysAB3         ?                Acinetobacter phage          modular endolysin; verify accession
LysAB4         ?                Acinetobacter phage          modular endolysin; verify accession
LysABP-01      ?                Acinetobacter phage AB-01    Lai 2011 Appl Microbiol Biotechnol
ABgp46         ?                Acinetobacter phage          Oliveira 2016; broad Gram-negative activity
